name: AdCP 3.2 Signature-Input header declares label 'sig1' twice (malformed structured dictionary, content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 1 (RFC 9421 §4.1 Signature-Input is a Dictionary; duplicate keys malformed); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/021-duplicate-signature-input-label.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The first sig1 member covers content-digest and its Signature is a valid Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, so the duplicate label is the only fault. The second sig1 member keeps the root vector's weaker component set, so a verifier that silently keeps one member accepts or rejects depending on which one it keeps; the only conformant outcome is rejecting the duplicate at step 1. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
